column1: # CAM-29 §2　RD 對帳 PARTIAL 中「含來源所載之點」53 列（64 點）之全案 465 列重判（不限同錨；含 B 本）
# verdict：COVERED-BY／TRUE-GAP（須於 SYS2 Description 逐字定位，evidence 為該片段）／NOT-IN-SOURCE（重判時定位不到 → RD 自加）；`internal-only`＝只涉內部訊號

column3: missing_point
column6: evidence

column3: button size and visual style shall follow the definition of HMI document
column6: source: "The softkey button shall perform similar to the other buttons within the same touch screen (i.e. press time to actuation, color change when pressed, size of button)." - RVC-035 checks only colour change ("changes colour while it is pressed, in the same way as the other buttons"); button size not checked by any TC; "HMI document" wording is RD-added

column3: the internal signal CHMC_IMAGE_ON shall be generated or received by the HU
column6: internal-only; source: "the HU shall receive the internal signal CHMC IMAGE ON" - RVC-036 checks only the cargo image, no TC checks the internal signal

column3: the HU shall generate and receive the internal signal CHMC IMAGE OFF
column6: internal-only; source: "the HU shall receive the internal signal CHMC IMAGE OFF" (source says receive only; "generate" is RD-added) - RVC-095 checks only that the cargo image closes

column3: The soft button shall not be selectable when $PowerMode$ = [OFF], [ACC], or any other state
column6: source: "The Rear View Camera soft button shall be selectable only when the signal $PowerMode$ = [IGN_RUN]." - ACC covered by NR1L-RVC-024 ("Send CAN: BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts = 3 (ACC) ... cannot be selected") and NR1L-RVC-106; OFF / other states not tested

column3: When $PowerMode changes from [IGN_RUN] to any other state (e.g., ACC, OFF) (only ACC is tested; OFF not verified)
column6: source: "When the signal $PowerMode$ <> [IGN_RUN], the HU shall follow the HMI Logic & Flow to update the state of the Rear View Camera soft button." - only ACC tested (RVC-024, RVC-106); OFF / other states not tested (can share the TC with CAM-073)

column3: The Rear Camera image shall remain continuously displayed on the head unit screen once activated.
column6: RVCHMI-029 (Manual Display Mode, 205): "The RVC+PAM layout remains displayed"; RVC-026 (Manual, 206): "The rear view camera image is still displayed" (snapshot reads, no long hold)

column3: The image shall not disappear automatically unless the driver performs a softkey press to disable it.
column6: source: "Rear Camera display image shall remain displayed until driver presses the softkey to disable it." - no TC holds Manual Display Mode below 8 mph beyond 10 s and checks the image does not close by itself; RVC-028 only checks the softkey close

column3: The camera image shall not disappear until both of the following conditions are satisfied: Display timer exceeds 10 seconds, and Vehicle speed exceeds 8 mph (no TC holds speed > 8 mph and checks the image stays until the 10 s timer expires; RVC-009 expects closing within 10 s, RVC-007/008 expect closing after 10 s below 8 mph)
column6: RVCHMI-033 (206 = above threshold, manual press): "The RVC+PAM layout is displayed although the speed is above the threshold" ... "Wait 10 seconds from the recorded timestamp without changing the gear or the speed" -> "no longer displayed"; RVC-026: 206 "The rear view camera image is still displayed" (no intermediate read just before 10 s)

column3: the system shall generate and receive the internal signal RVC IMAGE OFF
column6: internal-only; source: "the HU shall receive the internal signal RVC IMAGE OFF" (source says receive; "generate" is RD-added) - RVC-047 checks only that the image closes

column3: No unintended or repeated signal transmission shall occur unless another keypress event is detected.
column6: RD-added: source only states "send an on-change $SVC_SoftBtn_Rq$ = [Pressed] within <Tsend> of keypress"; no statement about unintended/repeated transmission

column3: When a new keypress occurs, the signal state changes accordingly (e.g., to [Pressed] or another defined state).
column6: RVC-038: "Press the virtual Surround View Camera button" -> "PENDING: DR-CAM-j an on-change SVC_SoftBtn_Rq = Pressed is sent within Tsend of the keypress" (ER pending DR-CAM-j)

column3: When the system (HU) is powered ON or rebooted, the Surround View camera shall remain OFF by default.
column6: RD-added: source only states "The default setting for the Surround View camera shall be OFF." (no power-on/reboot condition); default OFF itself covered by NR1L-RVC-048 "The Surround View camera setting is off" after factory reset

column3: The video display and signal transmission shall occur within the specified timing window (<Tsend>)
column6: RVC-040: "PENDING: DR-CAM-j the SVC_DisplaySts = SVC image displayed signal is sent to the CVPM within Tsend of the keypress" (ER pending DR-CAM-j; display latency itself not timed)

column3: If the vehicle speed is ≥ 8 mph, pressing the SVC button shall not activate the display
column6: RD-added: source only defines the $Speedometer$ < [8 MPH] case; >= 8 mph behaviour is in CAM-092 (grey-out, RVC-041)

column3: The grey-out action shall be completed within <Tdisplay> (defined display update time).
column6: source: "the HU shall grey-out the Surround View Camera soft button, as specified by HMI, within <Tdisplay>" - RVC-041 checks grey-out only ("The Surround View Camera soft button is greyed out"), no Tdisplay timing

column3: The Surround View Camera display status remains unchanged within the specified time <Tdisplay>.
column6: RVC-042: "Send CAN: BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 8191 (SNA)" -> "The Surround View Camera soft button is still shown in the available state" (retention verified; Tdisplay not timed)

column3: Upon the next keypress, the HU shall update or stop sending $CameraDisplaySts$ according to the corresponding display transition logic.
column6: RVC-045: "Press the virtual Forward Facing Camera button" -> "RADIO_B3.CameraDisplaySts = 3 (View_3) is sent on change"

column3: for all defined states and ranges
column6: RD-added: source only "gate PROXI PAM_Tuning_Set value to the LVDS signal: vehicleUpdate_2.PAM_Tuning_Set"; RVC-163 tests one value (1 Base)

column3: for all defined states and ranges
column6: RD-added: source only "gate PROXI CAN node 27 (ASM/ASCM) value to LVDS vehicleUpdate_1.NetCfg_ASCM"; RVC-138 tests Present only

column3: for all defined states and ranges
column6: RD-added: source only "gate PROXI Steering_Ratio_Rack_Pinion_Type to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.VC_Steering_Cfactor"; partially exercised by RVC-164/165/166 ("15.5" -> Type_1, "not 15.5" -> not Type_1)

column3: continue to transmit LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.ASCM_Stat = [SNA] as long as the ASCM_FD_2.ASCM_Stat signal remains missing
column6: RD-added: source "sends LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.ASCM_Stat= SNA when FD-CAN8 ASCM_FD_2.ASCM_Stat is missing" has no continuous/as-long-as clause; SNA-on-missing covered by RVC-161

column3: correctly evaluate the condition: Hybrid_Type != "Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" AND Hybrid_Type != "Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle"
column6: source: "when FD-CAN8 TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition is missing and Hybrid_Type != "Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" OR "Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle"" - RVC-157 has no Hybrid_Type precondition; REPB/FCEV exclusion untested (RVC-111 sets Hybrid_Type only for the display path)

column3: correctly evaluate the condition: Hybrid_Type != "Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" AND Hybrid_Type != "Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle"
column6: source: "gate FD-CAN8 TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition when Hybrid_Type != "Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" OR "Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle"" - RVC-156 has no Hybrid_Type precondition; REPB/FCEV exclusion untested

column3: precise adherence to any defined scaling factors, unit conversions, and sign conventions (e.g., degrees, radians, direction)
column6: RD-added: source only "gate FD-CAN8 STEERING1.LwsAngle_SCCM to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.LwsAngle"; no scaling/sign convention stated

column3: at all valid input ranges, considering any specified scaling or conversion factors
column6: RD-added: source only "gate FD-CAN8 BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig"; no range/scaling stated (RVC-150/167 test one value)

column3: under any operating condition, including power-up, normal operation, error conditions, mode changes, and power-down sequences
column6: source: "The HU shall never send gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts = [SNA] to RVCM." - RVC-120/127 record only in Full-Operation ("gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts is never sent as SNA in the whole recording"); power-up / power-down not recorded (enumerated conditions are RD wording)

column3: c. each value of systemStatus.ZoomViewRes
column6: source: "for each value of systemStatus.ZoomViewRes." - RVC-130 does not set ZoomViewRes; RVC-131/132/133 set 1X/4X/SNA only at 205 (below threshold)

column3: wait for reverse debounce time (Reverse_Deb = 750 ms)
column6: source: "Shift Lever changes to Reverse ShiftLeverPosition = R > Reverse_Deb" (750 ms value is RD-added) - RVC-011 (from RVC image active) has no debounce hold; RVC-019/020 test Reverse_Deb only from no-image state

column3: Precondition: Head Unit is in Manual Display mode
column6: RD-added: source only "When any of the preceding conditions occur, the Head Unit shall switch back to non-camera display operation."; Manual Display Mode precondition not stated (RVC-098 uses Automatic Display Mode)

column3: IGN != RUN (BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts != RUN)
column6: RD-added: IGN != RUN not stated in this description ("preceding conditions" undefined here); behaviour exercised by NR1L-RVC-017 "CmdIgnSts = 3 (ACC) ... no longer displayed" and NR1L-RVCHMI-002

column3: RVC image defeat button is pressed.
column6: RD-added: defeat button not stated in this description; behaviour exercised by NR1L-RVC-242 "RVC_ImageDefeat.Req = Pressed ... no longer displayed"

column3: VehicleSpeed >= c_VEHSPD_MAX and last for 10 seconds (Ttimer2)
column6: RD-added: speed/Ttimer2 condition not stated in this description; behaviour exercised by NR1L-RVCHMI-033 (206, wait 10 s -> "no longer displayed")

column3: The RVC image shall last for Ttimer1 (10 seconds)
column6: RVCHMI-034 (B, all vehicles incl. HDCC27/DT27, delay On, shift to D): "Wait 10 seconds from the recorded timestamp" -> "The RVC+PAM layout remains displayed during the timeout ... is no longer displayed"; also RVCHMI-035 (9 s still shown / 11 s off)

column3: App shall not interrupt the rear camera image display if Audio Mode is OFF. (anchored TC runs in Audio Mode ON)
column6: Description ("The Head Unit shall not interrupt the rear camera image display.") names no Audio Mode; Audio Mode OFF belongs to sibling SYS-RA-VF551_V2-506, already verified by NR1L-RVC-217: "The HU is in Audio Mode OFF ... The rear view camera image is not interrupted"

column3: when the head unit executes entertainment and non-entertainment features (TC only opens App Drawer; no entertainment feature executed)
column6: Source: "When the head unit executes entertainment and non-entertainment features, the Head Unit shall not interrupt the rear camera image display." NR1L-RVC-218 only opens App Drawer; NR1L-RVC-115/-219 only read "features are functional" without executing any feature

column3: accurately reflect the current value of the IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.LanguageSelection signal received by the Head Unit (TC changes language via HU Settings UI, signal not driven/checked)
column6: Source: "correspond to the Language signal, IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.LanguageSelection". NR1L-RVC-233/-113 change language via Settings > Language UI only; no TC sends or reads IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.LanguageSelection

column3: (or is 'Open' upon camera activation)
column6: Description only states "when BCM_FD_9.RHatchSts = Open"; the hatch-already-Open-at-camera-activation scenario is an RD addition. Existing NR1L-RVC-049 covers the Closed->Open transition while image is displayed

column3: for five seconds (TC reads within 5 s but does not verify 5 s display duration)
column6: RVCHMI-173 (B, all vehicles incl. HDCC27/DT27): "Read the HU display 4 seconds after the recorded timestamp and check that the message is still shown / 6 seconds after ... no longer shown" for "Check Entire Surroundings"

column3: if and only if ShiftLeverPosition is not R (e.g., P, N, D) (only D verified; P, N not verified; absence of [X] in R not verified)
column6: D: RVC-021 "The X exit button is overlaid on the rear view camera image"; P: RVC-005 (shift lever in P) "displayed in Manual Display Mode with the X exit button overlaid"; R: RVCHMI-041 "No X button is shown on the camera image while the gear is R". N not named in source (source says only "!= R")

column3: available (enabled and visible) state when BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts is exactly RUN
column6: RVC-023 (all vehicles, Full-Operation/RUN): "The Rear View Camera entry is shown in the available state and can be selected"

column3: unavailable (greyed out or hidden) state when BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts is not RUN (e.g., OFF, ACC) (only ACC verified, OFF not)
column6: Source: "shall be in the available state only when BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts = RUN". Only ACC verified (NR1L-RVC-106/-024 "CmdIgnSts = 3 (ACC) ... not in the available state"); no TC checks soft key state at IGN_LK/OFF (RVCHMI-002 checks image, not soft key)

column3: transmit its value on the LVDS interface accurately, reflecting its internal state or the most current vehicle data (TC checks presence only, no values)
column6: Description only lists signals the HU "shall transmit ... on LVDS"; value accuracy is RD addition. Value gating is specified/verified under separate gate requirements (e.g. NR1L-RVC-154, -156, -158 "reports the same value and is sent over LVDS")

column3: set APP_Menu_BACKUP.Req= Pressed (internal signal not checked; TC checks camera display only)
column6: internal-only. Source: "set internal Signal APP_Menu_BACKUP.Req= Pressed". No TC in corpus references APP_Menu_BACKUP (NR1L-RVC-005 checks camera display only)

column3: set RVC_ImageDefeat.Req = Pressed (internal signal not checked; TC checks screen restore only)
column6: internal-only. RVC-242 (all vehicles): "The RVC Image soft button registers the press and the HU sets RVC_ImageDefeat.Req = Pressed"; RVC-205 (637): "the internal RVC_ImageDefeat.Req becomes Pressed"

column3: For every update of EPS_FD_1.LwsAngle (TC sends single value 0.0 deg)
column6: Description: "shall gate FD-CAN8 EPS_FD_1.LwsAngle to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.LwsAngle" - no "every update"/multi-value requirement; RD addition. Gating itself verified by NR1L-RVC-154

column3: When Hybrid_Type is set to a non-EV value (e.g., ICE) (Hybrid_Type not configured in TC)
column6: Source: "when Hybrid_Type != "Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" OR "Battery Electric Vehicle"". NR1L-RVC-158/-156 do not configure Hybrid_Type; NR1L-RVC-111 sets Hybrid_Type but checks display only, not LVDS

column3: every update of TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition (single value R only)
column6: Description: "shall gate FD-CAN8 TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition" - no "every update" requirement; RD addition

column3: For ICE or HEV variants (Hybrid_Type not configured in TC)
column6: Source: "is missing and Hybrid_Type != "Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" OR "Battery Electric Vehicle"". NR1L-RVC-159 stops TRANSM_FD_4 but does not set Hybrid_Type; no SNA TC with Hybrid_Type configured

column3: Confirm the RVCM power line remains energized for the full Tpower period after ignition is locked
column6: RVC-072 (637/2261/376; Tpower = 5 s per its reasoning): "Hold for 5 s / Read the LVDS supply to the RVCM and check that it is still present" -> "The HU is still supplying power to the RVCM over LVDS"

column3: The message must disappear exactly after 5 seconds if the view remains active
column6: RVCHMI-173 (B, all vehicles incl. 637/2261/376): "still shown 4 seconds after the transition / no longer shown 6 seconds after the transition"

column3: Font size must exceed 18 arc minutes based on the defined design viewing distance, complying with ISO 15008
column6: Source: "This warning text shall be in accordance with ISO font 15008 and sized greater than 18 arc minutes." Font TCs NR1L-RVC-112/-235/-236 are HDCC27/DT27 only; no V3-vehicle (637/2261/376) font/size TC

column3: Verify "Camera Not in Position" appears first for 5s
column6: Source: "displays the text, "Camera Not in Position" for five seconds ... followed by ''check entire surroundings''". NR1L-RVC-050 only reads "within 5 s" and "after the first text is removed"; the 5 s duration of "Camera Not in Position" is not timed (NR1L-RVC-051 asserts "for 5 s" but for 2261/STATUS_BH_BCM.RHatchSts, not STATUS_BH_BCM1)

column3: using ISO 15008 font, with a visual size > 18 arc minutes
column6: Source: "This warning text shall be in accordance with ISO font 15008 and sized greater than 18 arc minutes." No font/size TC for "Camera Not in Position" nor for V3 vehicles (NR1L-RVC-112/-235/-236 are HDCC27/DT27, Check Entire Surroundings)

column3: Every language option available in the IPC must have a corresponding, accurate translation for all camera warning strings
column6: Source: "The warning text shall be available in all languages supported by the Head Unit". NR1L-RVC-234 selects only one other language and checks a single warning text

column3: The final displayed image must maintain the aspect ratio defined in the PDO (e.g., 16:10) without unintended stretching or squeezing
column6: RVC-200 (637 only): "check that the rear view image fills the display without distortion" -> "The image is scaled to the display that PROXI Radio_Display_Type configures". Source only says "refer to HMI and PDO for the aspect ratio"; 2261/376 not covered

column3: Rear_Camera_Enable.Info must be TRUE only when the RVC video frames are being rendered; it must be FALSE in all other HMI states
column6: internal-only. RVC-090: "The HU reports its current display status as being displayed"; RVC-089: "The HU reports its current display status as not being displayed". "all other HMI states" is RD expansion

column3: The system must NOT trigger the RVC display if the gear remains in REVERSE for a time shorter than Reverse_Deb
column6: Source: "Gear_Stat.info = [REVERSE] > Reverse_Deb". Negative case covered only for HDCC27/DT27 by NR1L-RVC-020 ("Hold for less than Reverse_Deb ... No camera image is displayed"); no V3-vehicle (637/2261/376) TC

column3: The image must exit immediately if: 1) Ign != RUN, 2) Speed >= c_VEHSPD_MAX, 3) Gear = Park, or 4) User presses the [X] button
column6: Ign: RVC-017 "CmdIgnSts = 3 (ACC) ... no longer displayed"; Park: RVC-018 "ShiftLeverPosition = 1 (P) ... no longer displayed"; Speed during delay: RVC-009 (376) / RVC-030 (637/2261) "no longer displayed"; [X] during delay: RVCHMI-037 "The camera image is turned off". Note 017/018 precondition is Automatic Display Mode, not explicitly the delay period

column3: RVC must exit immediately if Ign != RUN, Gear = PARK, or the user presses [X]
column6: Source: "unless one of these conditions occur: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts != [RUN] OR Shift Lever status change to "Park" from other gears". [X] in Manual mode covered (NR1L-RVC-028/-047), but no TC exits Manual Display Mode via Ign != RUN or D->P

column3: If Speed >= c_VEHSPD_MAX, the view must remain for Ttimer2 seconds before closing
column6: RVCHMI-033 (B, all vehicles): speed 206 (above threshold), manual activation, "Wait 10 seconds ... The RVC+PAM layout is no longer displayed". Caveat: Ttimer2 value not asserted as 10 s in corpus; no A-book TC times the Ttimer2 max-out

column3: If Speed drops below c_VEHSPD_MAX before Ttimer2 expires, the timer must reset to zero and the view must remain active
column6: RVC-029 (all vehicles, Manual Display Mode): "VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 206 ... Ttimer2 starts / = 205 ... The rear view camera image stays displayed and Ttimer2 is reset to zero"

column3: The RVC image must NOT flicker, blank, or restart when the gear shifts to Reverse while a manual RVC session is already active
column6: RVC-012 (637/2261/376, Manual -> R): "The rear view camera image stays displayed and the mode changes to Automatic Display Mode". Flicker/restart specifics are RD elaboration of "continue to display"

column3: No valid or stale ReverseGearSts value shall be propagated over LVDS while the CAN signal is in a missing state
column6: RVC-174 (376) / RVC-176 (637): "Stop transmitting STATUS_CCAN4 ... vehicleUpdate_2.ReverseGearSts = SNA is sent over LVDS" (no stale value propagated)

column3: When the LVDS video signal is restored under Ignition ON working conditions, the Head Unit shall: Clear the corresponding DTC. Automatically recover and resume all related camera functionalities to normal operation.
column6: Source: "If in the "Ignition On" "Working Condition", and the Head Unit receives the LVDS Video Signal, the LTM must: o Clear the DTC. o All related functionalities shall revert back to normal operation conditions." Recovery covered only for HDCC27/DT27 (NR1L-RVC-198) and 637 (NR1L-RVC-212 "The DTC is set to not present ... all related functionalities operate normally"); none for 376 (anchor NR1L-RVC-199 is set-only)
